thread:
incident-bot: Pager fired for `metering.ingest.offset_error` — 150+ minute consumer lag on token-aggregation pipeline, high error rate, and checkpoint mismatch. Pager: P12345. @pagerduty-bot details here: https://pd.example/p/12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: ALERT -> triggered (severity: high). Assigned to miguel.

miguel: acked. pulling logs and offsets now. quick note: this looks like the kafka consumer stopped committing for partition range 12-18. seeing `OffsetOutOfRange` + repeated checkpoint writes.

emily: oncall grabbing triage. any immediate customer impact?

miguel: immediate: token counts for ~1h 45m window underreported. upstream ingestion still receiving samples but aggregator dropped batches. rough estimate: ~1.2M tokens missing across 28 customers, top 3 customers could see invoice delta > 10%.

raj: copying billing: @billing-team — we may need to put invoices on hold until counts are reconciled. Can you confirm risk tolerance & process?

billing-team: reading. request: list of affected customers + delta estimate. if >5% for an invoice window we usually put manual invoice hold. keep us updated.

miguel: running quick query against `metering.aggregates` to confirm gaps. command I ran:

```
SELECT count_tokens, window_start FROM metering.aggregates
WHERE window_start BETWEEN '2026-03-14T01:00Z' AND '2026-03-14T03:00Z'
AND partition IN (12,13,14,15,16,17,18)
ORDER BY window_start;
```

miguel: sample result shows zeros for many windows that should have non-zero. suspect checkpoint corruption: consumer checkpoint file at s3://metering-checkpoints/prod/consumer-12 is truncated.

emily: mitigation plan (short term):
- flip aggregator to fallback mode (stateless count merge) to stop further drops.
- run targeted backfill job to reprocess raw events for affected partitions.
- create a safe invoice hold list and notify billing.

miguel: executed flip: `infra playbook metering flip-aggregator --mode=fallback --partitions=12-18` -> returns jobid: fb-789. monitoring now, traffic should flow to fallback within ~2min.

pagerduty-bot: escalation to next layer scheduled in 15m if not resolved.

raj: miguel — can you kick off backfill and share estimated completion time? also add a flag to avoid double-counting when reingesting.

miguel: starting backfill job: `jobs run metering-backfill --from=2026-03-14T01:00Z --to=2026-03-14T03:00Z --partitions=12-18 --dedupe=true` job: backfill-321. ETA roughly 3 hours (IO-bound). will stream progress to this thread.

sophia: i'm taking next-shift handoff in 30m. any ops playbook I should be aware of?

miguel: key checks:
- `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group=token-aggregator` (look for lag/offsets)
- check s3 checkpoint objects: `aws s3 ls s3://metering-checkpoints/prod/consumer-*/`
- backfill job logs: `kubectl logs job/backfill-321 -n metering`
- watch `alerts.metering.ingest_recovery` for stability signal

miguel: logs snippet from consumer pod:
```
2026-03-14T02:12:09Z ERROR consumer 12: OffsetOutOfRangeError: commit failed for offset 23452345
2026-03-14T02:12:09Z WARN checkpoint-writer: write truncated, expected 4096 bytes got 128
2026-03-14T02:13:02Z INFO reconnected and switched to fallback aggregator
```

emily: billing-team — we need a preliminary hold for any invoices that close within the affected windows. miguel will provide affected customer ids in next update. please prep hold workflow and communication template.

billing-team: acknowledged. starting draft hold list and email template. will wait for final numbers before executing holds.

miguel: initial affected customers (by id): C-1023, C-2075, C-3099, C-4121. estimated token shortfall: [C-1023: 480k, C-2075: 220k, C-3099: 190k, C-4121: 160k]. sending CSV to billing in a few mins.

emily: risk assessment: potential revenue delta ~ $1.8k for top customers, but customer experience risk higher if we ship incorrect invoices. recommend manual hold for those >$500 delta.

miguel: backfill progress update: 18% processed. no duplicates observed so far due to `--dedupe=true`. job log tail:
```
backfill-321: processed 3200 batches, reingested 450k events
backfill-321: ETA ~2h25m
```

pagerduty-bot: reminder: escalation in 8m.

emily: if fallback aggregator stays healthy for 15m and backfill continues, don't escalate. miguel please call if any lineup stalls.

miguel: FYI I created a short-lived alert suppression rule for `metering.ingest.duplicate_alerts` to avoid noise during backfill (expires in 6h).

sophia: taking handoff early. summary for night oncall: fallback aggregator enabled for partitions 12-18, backfill job backfill-321 running (ETA ~2h), billing notified and prepping holds, affected customers list sent. contact miguel or emily for escalation. I'll monitor and post hourly updates.

emily: thanks. leaving a runbook note in incidents: https://internal.docs/runbooks/metering-offset-corruption. please paste any final remediation steps here.

miguel: follow-ups to do: 1) repair checkpoint writer (likely bug in S3 multipart commit), 2) add stronger checksum before checkpoint write, 3) postmortem + customer outreach draft.

billing-team: will hold invoices for C-1023 and C-2075 pending final reconciliation. placing manual invoice hold now.

sophia: acknowledging handoff. I'll ping when backfill hits 50% and when completed.

emily: phew. thanks team. keep this thread alive with status.

pagerduty-bot: ALERT resolved automatically: fallback aggregator active and consumer restarted; primary alarm cleared. (Note: backfill still in progress)."
